name: mcp-apidesk
description: HTTP debugging and regression workbench for coding agents.
long_description:
API Desk is a local HTTP workbench for coding agents. While an agent writes or modifies HTTP code, API Desk lets it verify the work immediately: send real requests against dev/staging/prod environment profiles, interpolate `{{variables}}`, and pull values like auth tokens out of responses into later requests.

Proven requests are saved into a collection — plain JSON, meant to be committed. One command replays every saved request in order, threads captured tokens through the chain, and reports assertion failures with expected vs. actual. A regression suite that grows while you develop, not after.

Secrets live in a local vault and are injected at send time; they never appear in responses, errors, or request previews. No dependencies, no proxying, no telemetry.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check: reports the state directory, Node version, and active environment.

tools.name: env
tools.description: List or switch environment profiles (host plus per-environment variables).

tools.name: secret
tools.description: Store API keys per environment; list shows key names only, never values.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Send an HTTP request with {{variable}} interpolation and response capture, or save a proven request into the collection.

tools.name: collection
tools.description: Show the saved collection, or replay every request in order with assertions and report pass/fail.
